Train your stats, unlock transformations, and master unique techniques to become the strongest warrior in the multiverse.

[E] Combat | [Q] Ki Blast

[G] Vanish | [Z] Toggle Aura

[X] Scouter | [Double Jump] Fly

[L1/LB] + [R1/RB] → Scouter
[L1/LB] + [Square/X] → Toggle Aura
[L3] Boost Flight | [Double A/Cross] Fly
